subject: Subject: Research Enquiry - Great House Farm, Llandough (Williams/Buckler, Bute Estates, Daniel Thomas)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Enquiries,

Please search and advise on/provide access to: Bute Estate collections,
maps, title references, family papers, or manuscripts relating to Great
House Farm, Llandough; Daniel Thomas quarry deal/swap; John/Mary Williams
occupation/ownership claims.

For generational land history and reparations research. Copies/fees welcome.


Requester Ret'd Sgt
